description: Second runtime: the shared MCP server is written in Node.js with the official TypeScript SDK (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.1); one process and one JavaScript thread serve every session. Tools: async_get (timer, then net.connect), subproc_get (spawns node -e connect), http_get (node:http client, no keep-alive). Manual binding (the tools emit markers at start and end, thread-keyed) versus automatic binding (fact_rt_node: identity in AsyncLocalStorage from _meta, handed to the kernel at the libuv connect and at spawn; the tools emit nothing). Same reference (destination port -> execution).
